text: Over the last 30 days, visitor reviews have highlighted issues with the food quality at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Two reviews specifically mentioned salads and other menu items lacking flavor or having awkward combinations. One review noted the menu includes healthy options but suggested the recipes need adjustment. Overall, the average rating was low, indicating dissatisfaction with the dining experience. There were no comments on other aspects of the library in this period.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days highlight issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several comments mention salads lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and one reviewer found the venison chili bland. There are concerns about portion size and pricing, with one visitor describing the offerings as minimal and overpriced. Additionally, a lack of basic service items like cups for water was noted. Overall, the average rating is low, indicating these areas need attention.
windows.90: Visitor feedback over the last 90 days indicates ongoing issues with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several reviews mention bland or poorly prepared dishes, limited menu options, and dissatisfaction with portion sizes and pricing. Some visitors also noted problems with service, including the refusal to provide cups for water. Wait times and the overall atmosphere received fewer comments but remain areas to monitor. Addressing these concerns could improve the overall visitor experience.
